flow_iv.note: history = earlier completed sessions from history/flow_iv (kept since 2026-09-28); missing days were not recorded

definition.dp_pct: dark_pool_volume / (dark_pool_volume + regular_volume) per UW price bucket
definition.top8: 8 buckets with the most dark_pool_volume in the window
definition.windows: 1D = window_end, 2D / 3D = last 2 / 3 sessions, 1W = last 5 sessions, 1M = last 21 sessions (bucket volumes summed)
definition.poc: bucket with the most dark_pool_volume in the window (dominant grey node)
definition.snapshots: single sessions: window_end, 5 and 21 sessions earlier

option-trades.reason: empty payload: no option trades for the ticker on the latest day

data.note: row picked by date == D (max date), never by position

notes: FINRA short interest lags; 22 calendar days behind 2026-11-06

lit-blocks.reason: empty payload: no lit prints on 2026-11-06

derived.hv20_definition: annualized stdev of the last 20 daily log returns (close to close) x sqrt(252)

bars_4h.definition: RTH only; AM = 09:30-13:30 ET, PM = 13:30-16:00 ET; n5m = 5m bars (48 / 30 when complete)

data.note: curr_oi vs last_oi, with the prior session's ask/bid volume on the same row (SHORT_ENGINE §6.2)

data.definition: iv30 = UW implied_volatility (30 calendar days) on date; rv21_trailing = UW realized_volatility (21 sessions) keyed to the window's last day

data.note: AVAR = call vs put IV asymmetry (upside-tail proxy); VWKS = volume-weighted strike vs spot
risk_reversal = collar shape; vertical / diagonal / calendar = roll shapes
open-interest basis; cross-check for gex-levels (vol basis by default); dex = UW call_delta / put_delta per strike
